# Booked Job

Booked Job (booked-job.com) is a free, no-fluff marketing education resource for home-service contractors — HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, and the rest of the trades. We publish the real math behind getting booked: what a lead actually costs per BOOKED JOB, whether platforms like Angi are worth it, how many Google reviews it takes to rank, and how to build a pipeline you own instead of rent. Content is data-first, sourced, and written contractor-to-contractor. No agency pitch; the courses, articles, calculators, and podcast are free.

## Key facts
- What: free contractor-marketing education — articles, Marketing 101 course, calculators, podcast, videos
- Who it's for: home-service contractors and trades business owners (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, pest control, lawn care)
- Signature analysis: cost per booked job (not cost per lead) — e.g. Angi ≈ $542 vs Google LSA ≈ $168 per booked job
- Podcast: "Get Booked, Not F***ed" — two tradesmen run the real numbers; on Spotify, YouTube, and RSS
- Price: everything free; email newsletter at booked-job.com
- Contact: hello@booked-job.com
- Founder: Aaron Phillips

Full article text (all pages, one file): https://booked-job.com/llms-full.txt

## Pages
- https://booked-job.com/ : homepage — free Marketing 101 course + tools for contractors
- https://booked-job.com/blog/ : all articles — lead costs, reviews, local SEO, platform math
- https://booked-job.com/blog/is-angi-worth-it/ : the honest Angi math (shared leads, refunds, FTC case)
- https://booked-job.com/blog/get-more-google-reviews/ : the one-tap review system for contractors
- https://booked-job.com/blog/cost-per-lead-vs-cost-per-booked-job/ : the two numbers that run your marketing
- https://booked-job.com/tools/ : free calculators — cost per booked job, Google review targets, job pricing, hourly rate, marketing budget
- https://booked-job.com/tools/hourly-rate-calculator/ : what a contractor must charge per hour (pay + overhead ÷ billable hours)
- https://booked-job.com/tools/marketing-budget-calculator/ : how much a contractor should spend on marketing (revenue goal ÷ average job × cost per booked job)
- https://booked-job.com/tools/cost-per-booked-job-calculator/ : lead price ÷ close rate = real cost per booked job
- https://booked-job.com/podcast/ : the podcast — episodes, audio feed (feed.xml), show notes
- https://booked-job.com/sitemap.xml : full list of pages
